title: Appreciation & Acknowledgments

design_system.title: Design System
design_system.description: This page follows our design system: Poppins/Almarai font stack, Tailwind-based spacing and the primary/secondary color palette used across the site.

thanks.title: Thank You
thanks.message: We extend our sincere gratitude to all maintainers, contributors, and designers in the open-source ecosystem. Your work empowers communities worldwide.
